presentation.chief_complaint: Dyspnea, Edema, Orthopnea in the setting of Acute systolic (congestive) heart failure
presentation.history_of_present_illness: A 55-year-old Female is admitted with Acute systolic (congestive) heart failure. Presenting symptoms include Dyspnea, Edema, Orthopnea, present for several days and worsening. Home medications include spironolactone 25 MG Oral Tablet, furosemide 40 MG Oral Tablet, lisinopril 10 MG Oral Tablet, 24 HR metoprolol succinate 25 MG Extended Release Oral Tablet. The inpatient stay was brief. Symptoms and vital signs were observed, and the patient was judged ready for discharge home.
